caveats.composite_day: each location contributes its own latest covering date (2023-09-19..2026-06-30, 56 distinct days) — this demand is a COMPOSITE typical AM peak, not one observed morning
caveats.class_merge: cars+truck+bus merged per movement (the pipeline's mode taxonomy is car/bike/ped); no separate heavy-vehicle demand
caveats.bike: bike counts anchor APPROACH-LEVEL edgeData only (TMC bikes carry no turn resolution) — coarser than vehicle turn calibration
caveats.ped: ped counts are intersection CROSSINGS; they anchor a corridor-total walk scale, order-of-magnitude only — NO GEH claim for bike/ped
